title: [UE-0.10a] Swatch and locked post-process
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Integrator

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Art Director

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_StyleFrame.umap`, its `+MapsToCook` line in `Config/DefaultGame.ini`, its row in `pipeline/qa/no-player-maps.txt`, `pipeline/art/style.json` `unreal_import.texture.mips` (a gate file: Art Director human), `Content/UmbrellaElla/Art/Swatch/**`, `Art/Source/Swatch/**`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_StyleFrame.umap`, its `+MapsToCook` line in `Config/DefaultGame.ini`, its row in `pipeline/qa/no-player-maps.txt`, `pipeline/art/style.json` `unreal_import.texture.mips` (a gate file: Art Director human), `Content/UmbrellaElla/Art/Swatch/**`, `Art/Source/Swatch/**`
Do not touch: other maps under Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/
Locks: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_StyleFrame.umap

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.8, UE-0.12

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.10b, UE-0.10

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] Before the swatch import (the first art import), the agent sets `pipeline/art/style.json` `unreal_import.texture.mips` from D13, or D13's default (`mips`, 2x with mipmaps) while it is open, in the card's gate patch: `tests/test_sprite_check.py` fails once L_StyleFrame exists with it still null
- [ ] Kickoff applies it itself through the tool checks (`python3 tools/git_gate.py apply UE-0.10a --auto`: every path in the card's lane, no guardrail enforcer changed, no guardrail file loosened; the PR has a `GATE EDIT: by=kickoff` line naming the patched paths)
- [ ] The swatch sprite made by `python3 tools/make_art_calibration.py --swatch` is imported and placed in front of `CAM_Eval_Swatch` in L_StyleFrame, with its `+MapsToCook` line and an `L_StyleFrame` row (card 0.10a, style frame, no player) in `pipeline/qa/no-player-maps.txt` (the daily smokes every cooked map; a map with no player logs input=none)
- [ ] The post-process volume is set as `pipeline/art/art-bible.md` locks it (values pasted)
- [ ] `python3 tools/art_check.py --swatch` on the `-EvalCam=CAM_Eval_Swatch` capture prints PASS (pasted)

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
